context: Tests whether the agent recognizes a pass-through layer and restructures instead of adding a fourth identical method to each of three layers.

checklist.name: floor_update_works
checklist.description: A room's floor can be updated end to end through the controller.

checklist.name: pass_through_addressed
checklist.description: The solution does not simply add update_room_floor to all three layers with identical signatures. It either removes/merges the pure pass-through service layer, or generalizes the update path (e.g. a single update_room(room_id, **fields) with validated field names) so the change lives in one place.

checklist.name: future_fields_cheap
checklist.description: After the change, adding the next updatable field requires an edit in at most one layer.

checklist.name: no_unsafe_generalization
checklist.description: If a generic field-update path is introduced, field names are validated against an allowlist (no SQL built from unchecked caller input).

checklist.name: existing_behavior_kept
checklist.description: Name updates and the controller's response shapes still work as before.
